name: Dead Drop
tagline: Blind swaps at three shared drops; fill eight ledger slots, then the cipher pays out.
core_loop: Optionally swap one hand card blind with a centre drop or with a rival, then place a card on either end of your eight-slot ledger and score how well it matches its new neighbour.
win_condition: Most points after eight rounds, counting placement points plus the cipher payout on your ledger; ties break on ledger rank sum, then later seat.
